arms.label: Arms
arms.launchHint: A salvo at what the ship locked (M)
arms.torpedoHint: A torpedo at what the ship locked (K): slow, heavy, for big ships
arms.driveHint: The mass driver at the target, where its slug meets it (U)
arms.lanceHint: The lance at the target (I): it charges 3 s, then burns 1.5 s on it, 500 km
arms.railHint: The railgun faster than light at the target (O): 4 s charging, then a tunnel of warp takes its slug to where the target will be (or straight into it)
arms.hunterHint: A salvo of heavy missiles at what the ship locked (Y): 25 km/s, more harm; point defence and flares work against them
